verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents Providers as packages that connect it to external APIs, with managed resources such as AWS RDS instances. It positions itself as able to "manage any resource anywhere," with a component library and existing managed resources for common needs. Community commenters describe cloud-agnostic resources backed by cloud-specific controllers, portable across AWS, Azure and CloudSQL, and GitLab cites it as the missing piece for multi-cloud. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog showing official providers for GCP, Azure and other major clouds, evidence of SaaS-provider coverage, and hands-on corroboration of how broad and mature the ecosystem is.
